title: X-raying batteries under load - Batteries News
content:
X-raying batteries under load
Highly dynamic X-ray technology reveals what happens inside large battery cells in fractions of a second under load—accelerating the development of safer next-generation cells for the European automotive industry.
What happens inside a battery cell when it fails? Until now, cell manufacturers and
vehicle integrators have had to rely on simulations, destructive testing methods, and indirect measurements. The Fraunhofer Institute for High-Speed Dynamics, Ernst-Mach-Institut, EMI, has developed a globally unique high-speed X-ray system that makes dynamic processes inside large-format prismatic cells visible in real time for the first time. Together with the German cell manufacturer PowerCo, a Volkswagen Group company, Fraunhofer EMI is now bringing this technology into industrial use.
The system combines high-performance X-ray technology with a specially designed battery test chamber and advanced sensor systems that simultaneously capture temperature, pressure, voltage, and gas flow. Recording up to 1,000 images per second, it reveals processes such as gas formation, material displacement, and crack propagation inside the cell at extremely high resolution—events that until now have remained hidden from view.
Dr. Sebastian Schopferer,
Head of Battery Safety at Fraunhofer EMI, said:
Our in-situ method allows us to see what happens inside a cell in fractions of a second—in real time and at the highest resolution,
“This fundamentally changes how we understand battery design and safety.”
A key engineering milestone was the development of a protective chamber that reliably shields sensitive X-ray components from the extreme conditions generated during lithium-ion cell thermal runaway.
Proven in practice and already in use within the Volkswagen Group
This technology is more than theory: Fraunhofer EMI has already used it for several German car manufacturers, including VW and Audi, to characterize material ejection during thermal runaway and propagation behavior in multi-cell configurations. The resulting data enables engineers to assess cell designs based on directly observed processes and refine simulation models with greater precision—delivering direct added value for product development and certification processes.
Transfer to industry by 2028
In the next phase, Fraunhofer EMI and PowerCo will transfer the technology into industrial use. Fraunhofer EMI brings expertise in materials research, battery abuse testing, and high-speed imaging. PowerCo contributes production requirements and access to real-world cell types.
Initial results from the collaboration are already feeding into the development of optimized production cells at PowerCo, accelerating the path from research to industrial implementation. The system is scheduled for installation at PowerCo’s Salzgitter site in 2028.
Designed as a modular platform, the system can be scaled to different cell formats and new cell chemistries—an important advantage for future battery development.
HW Vassen,
CTO of PowerCo, said:
With in-situ high-speed X-ray imaging, we are taking battery research to a new level,
“For the first time, we can make the dynamic processes inside cells visible in real time and in slow motion. This unprecedented depth of insight allows us to optimize battery cell safety and design in a highly targeted way and bring innovations into industrial use much faster. Together with Fraunhofer EMI, we are advancing high technology made in Europe and are strengthening Europe’s role in the battery industry.”

title: Low-Frequency Noise and Data Centers: What to Know
content:
Most of the
noise that frustrates neighbors
around data centers is audible. But one important factor isn’t: infrasound – low-frequency acoustic energy that most people can’t actually hear, yet may perceive as pressure changes, vibrations, or even building rattle. As communities scrutinize new projects, understanding what infrasound is, where it comes from, and how to control it is increasingly important.
What Is Infrasound?
Infrasound refers to acoustic energy typically below 20 Hz, which sits beneath the usual range of human hearing. Although it’s often inaudible, people can sometimes
sense infrasound
indirectly – as subtle body pressure, vibration in nearby structures, or resonance that causes doors, windows, or fittings to buzz.
Where Infrasound Comes From in Data Centers
Infrasound arises from both natural and human-made sources.
Ocean waves
, storms, and seismic activity all produce low-frequency energy. In data centers, several systems can contribute:
Related:
Delivery Certainty Will Define the Next Phase of Data Center Growth
Cooling towers
and large axial fans
can emit low-frequency sound waves that propagate beyond the site, especially under certain wind or atmospheric conditions.
Standby generators
– through engines, exhaust systems, and enclosures – are common sources of low-frequency noise and infrasound during testing or outages.
Server fans
primarily contribute mid- to high-frequency noise; however, in aggregate, they can also contribute to low-frequency hum through airflow paths and structural resonance. They are typically secondary sources compared to cooling plants and generators.
Why Low-Frequency Noise Matters
Most people can’t hear infrasound, and many ordinances address only audible sound. For these reasons, one might think that the data center industry has little reason to be concerned about high levels of infrasound.
In reality, infrasound is increasingly
part of debates
about the impact of data centers on local communities, with residents complaining that low-frequency noise and infrasound produce
headaches, nausea, anxiety
, and other health problems.
So far, most of these claims have not been fully validated. Measuring infrasound accurately requires specialized equipment, and few communities have conducted the assessments necessary to prove infrasound at high levels – let alone to prove that data centers are the source of the sound or that it’s causing health problems.
Practical Ways to Reduce Infrasound
Data center operators aiming to stay in the good graces of local communities (not to mention politicians and regulators) would do well to invest in strategies for mitigating infrasound emissions from their facilities, whether real or perceived. Many options are practical and not especially costly:
Related:
The AI Data Center Boom Is Here. Can Contractor Safety Keep Pace?
Regularly clean
fans and other mechanical components. Keeping blades and heat exchange surfaces clean helps equipment run smoothly and can reduce low-frequency noise and infrasound generation.
Install larger fans operating at lower speeds where feasible. Larger-diameter fans running at lower speeds can produce less low-frequency energy than smaller fans at higher RPM for equivalent airflow.
Use anti-vibration pads and proper isolation mounts to decouple infrasound-producing equipment from floors, walls, and other structural components. Low-frequency energy travels efficiently through solids, so preventing direct contact can significantly reduce transmission.
Optimize enclosures, mufflers, and silencers. Properly sealed and tuned enclosures around generators and large fans reduce low-frequency output during operations and testing.
Minimize generator runtime. Rely on the grid for normal operations, schedule tests during daytime windows, and
consider battery energy storage
to reduce generator use.
Consider active noise control in constrained paths. It can help in specific, controlled scenarios, but is rarely practical at a facility scale or in open-air environments, especially at very low frequencies. Prioritize source control and isolation first.
Evaluate alternative
cooling approaches
. Liquid cooling can reduce reliance on high airflow and the associated fan noise, but pumps and related components should be mounted and isolated to avoid introducing new low-frequency paths.
Related:
California Judge Orders Full Environmental Review of 330 MW Data Center
Engaging the Community with Data and Transparency
Beyond engineering controls, measurement and communication matter. Operators will likely win more hearts and minds if they have an open conversation about low-frequency noise and infrasound – including what’s been measured and what’s being done – rather than suggesting that the issue lies solely in neighbors’ heads.

title: Australian state approves 200 MWh battery despite 70-plus objections - Energy Storage
content: A 100 MW/200 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS) near Deniliquin in southern New South Wales has secured development consent despite more than 70 public objections. The Deniliquin East project will use approximately 80 containerized lithium-ion battery modules, with 120 MW/240 MWh of total cell capacity above its nominal rating. Applicant Bess Arctic Pty Ltd. lodged the project through Gransolar Development Australia , the Australian arm of Spain-headquartered Gransolar Group. According to the New South Wales Planning Portal, an executive director at the state planning department approved it on Sept. 24. The project was found to provide a range of energy, economic and employment benefits to the local community, including 52 construction and two operational jobs, and AUD 600,000 in community benefits for the approximately 9,000 permanent residents of the Edward River Council area. The site is about 7 km southeast of Deniliquin and 712 km southwest of Sydney. Objectors included several Save Our Surroundings campaign groups, some based as far away as Queensland and Victoria. Community concerns centered on fire risks and hazards, the merits of renewable energy and land-use compatibility. The developer responded with further project refinements, including readiness to comply with Fire and Rescue NSW recommendations. Six public submissions said adequate consultation had not been conducted. Gransolar pointed to the New South Wales Undertaking Engagement Guidelines for State Significant Projects, saying it had consulted government stakeholders, relevant agencies such as Transgrid, and Aboriginal stakeholders including the Deniliquin Local Aboriginal Land Council . It said it had also reached adjacent neighbors and the surrounding community through a newsletter, a community survey, local newspaper notices, pop-up community information sessions, the project website and freely available contact information. Assessors found the project’s 3.53-hectare footprint would result in a negligible loss of agricultural land in the Edward River local government area. The project is expected to operate until 2060. title: Delta Capacity advances second major Finland BESS this month with Sungrow supply deal - Energy Storage
content: Swiss developer Delta Capacity has confirmed contractors and suppliers for its second major Finnish battery storage project as construction gets underway. Construction has begun on the 125 MW / 300 MWh Kärppiö battery energy storage system (BESS) located in Teuva, western Finland, approximately 370 km northwest of Helsinki. It is being developed by Delta Capacity and the Strioga Family Foundation, with Sungrow supplying the BESS technology. Commissioning is planned for Q4 2027, with Delta Capacity set to serve as long-term asset manager. Delta Capacity confirmed Sungrow’s supply of batteries for the project, along with Nordic electrification specialist NEPower serving as balance-of-plant (BoP) contractor, as well as delivering electrification and substation works. Despro is acting as the local engineering partner. On the revenue front for Kärppiö, and under a different financing model than the AKKU One project, Delta Capacity has a partial tolling agreement with Centrica Energy that will optimize and trade the asset across Nordic power markets. Sungrow’s own press release provided further confirmation that it will also supply the BESS technology but didn’t specify the type, including for the 125 MW / 300 MWh AKKU One project , located in Lapinlahti, approximately 450 km northeast of Helsinki. The AKKU One BESS was acquired by Delta Capacity as a ready-to-build asset from Helios Nordic Energy; construction has already begun. “The Kärppiö and AKKU One projects demonstrate how strong local and international partners can implement large-scale battery storage projects quickly and to a high standard,” said Patrik Hes, CEO of Delta Capacity. “Together, these 600 MWh projects mark an important step in our long-term collaboration and strengthen our position in the Nordic energy market.” Earlier this year, Sungrow and Delta Capacity signed a 1 GWh framework agreement , which Sungrow said has now been fulfilled through supplies for the Karppio and AKKU One projects. title: Giga Storage starts construction on 2.8 GWh Belgian BESS - Energy Storage
content: Giga Storage has started construction of its 700 MW / 2.8 GWh Green Turtle battery energy storage system (BESS) in Belgium, a project that will become the country’s largest battery storage site by some margin. The four-hour project is being built on the former site of a zinc factory at the Rotem industrial estate in Dilsen-Stokkem, in Belgium’s Limburg province, at the far east of Belgium’s border with the southern tip of the Netherlands. Preparatory works began in mid-August, with the official start of construction marked on Sept. 17. Commissioning is currently scheduled for the end of March 2028. Green Turtle will comprise 640 Tesla Megapack 3 units and Tesla is acting as EPC contractor, covering engineering and construction as well as battery supply, and will provide long-term maintenance for the project. The Green Turtle site will also include 188 medium-voltage transformers and four high-voltage transformers. The project will connect directly to Belgium’s high-voltage network beside Elia’s 380 kV Van Eyck-Gramme transmission line. Elia is constructing a new high-voltage substation on the Rotem industrial estate for the connection. Giga Storage said the project’s capacity will be made available to Elia and market participants for grid balancing and congestion management. The start of construction follows financial close in July with a mix of borrowed cash and the owner’s own purse. A consortium of 10 banks is providing €450 million ($512.5 million) of debt financing, with the roughly €250 million remainder provided by Giga Storage majority owner InfraVia Capital Partners. Total investment in Green Turtle was said to be around €700 million. The banking group comprises ABN AMRO, ING, Rabobank, Triodos Bank, Triodos Investment Management, a.s.r., Belfius, Hamburg Commercial Bank, Santander and SMBC. Green Turtle will substantially increase the scale of battery storage operating in Belgium. Engie’s 200 MW / 800 MWh four-hour BESS at Vilvoorde became fully operational in November 2025 and is currently among the country’s largest operating projects. title: Greenvolt begins building 600 MW/2.4 GWh BESS in Poland - Energy Storage
content: Greenvolt Power has started construction of a 600 MW/2.4 GWh BESS in Siedlce, Poland. It said it expects to begin commercial operations by the end of 2027. BYD Energy Storage will supply the battery technology. The project will use 210 battery containers and 105 transformer containers equipped with power conversion systems to transfer electricity between the batteries and the grid. P&Q will connect the BESS to the transmission network operated by Polskie Sieci Elektroenergetyczne (PSE) at 400 kV. The connection works include a new 400/110 kV substation and 400 kV and 110 kV cable links. The facility will charge during periods of high renewable generation and discharge when electricity demand rises. Greenvolt expects the project to improve system flexibility, support the integration of wind and solar power, and help balance supply and demand. Greenvolt has expanded its battery storage portfolio across Europe, including behind-the-meter systems for commercial and industrial customers through its Greenvolt Next subsidiary. Greenvolt Power already operates a 200 MW/800 MWh battery storage project at Turośń Kościelna in Poland, which entered operation in July 2026. A second 200 MW/800 MWh project at Ełk is scheduled to enter commercial operation in the fourth quarter of 2026. Once Siedlce, Turośń Kościelna and Ełk are operating, Greenvolt will have 1 GW of battery power capacity and 4 GWh of storage capacity in Poland. The portfolio will give the company a larger role in providing flexibility as Poland expands variable renewable generation. title: Higher prices, different opportunities: battery revenues in August  - Energy Storage
content: As summer moved into its final stretch, the German power market remained anything but static. While August brought noticeably higher electricity prices, battery trading opportunities developed very differently across wholesale and ancillary service markets. Renewable generation remained high, while negative-price periods became less frequent. For battery operators, this set the stage for another strong month for cross-market optimization. To quantify these developments, we evaluated simulated earnings for a representative 10 MW/20 MWh Grey Standalone Storage in Germany. As in previous months, individual market strategies were benchmarked against Suena’s forecast-based cross-market optimization approach. Wholesale strategies weakened compared with July. Continuous intraday trading remained the strongest individual spot-market strategy at €12,900 ($14,710)/MW per month, although revenues declined about 10%. Day-ahead trading and intraday auctions, both at €12,300/MW per month in July, softened to €10,800/MW and €10,500/MW, respectively. The stacked wholesale strategy followed the same trend, declining from €17,100/MW to €15,400/MW per month. Ancillary services presented a more mixed picture. FCR edged up to €15,300/MW per month, making it the strongest individual strategy in August. Negative aFRR also improved to €14,000/MW per month. Positive aFRR, by contrast, declined markedly to €5,600/MW per month, while the stacked aFRR strategy reached €9,800/MW per month. Revenues from aFRR energy remained comparatively low at about €800/MW per month. The strongest overall result came from cross-market optimization. Suena’s approach generated €25,300/MW per month, 10% more than in July. This was 63% above the combined wholesale benchmark and 65% above FCR, the strongest individual strategy during the month. Negative hours August saw a clear increase in wholesale electricity prices. At over €126/MWh, the average day-ahead price was around €20/MWh higher than in July and roughly €50/MWh above the level recorded in August 2025. Among the main drivers were higher gas prices and tighter supply conditions in neighbouring markets such as France and Poland, where high temperatures, elevated demand and water-related constraints on power generation temporarily reduced the availability of electricity for imports into Germany. Renewables nevertheless remained a defining feature of the German power market, accounting for roughly 70% of electricity generation, only marginally below July’s output. Strong solar output created regular charging opportunities during the day, while the first signs of the seasonal transition became visible. As daylight hours shortened, solar generation began to decline earlier while electricity demand remained elevated in the late afternoon and early evening. As a result, residual demand picked up earlier, making the spread between lower-priced midday hours and higher-priced evening periods more pronounced. At the same time, negative-price periods became less frequent. Day-ahead prices fell below zero for 55 hours, compared with 79 hours in July, with these periods remaining concentrated around midday. This meant fewer deeply negative charging windows, even as higher-priced periods became more pronounced. August also highlighted the importance of forecast accuracy. During the partial solar eclipse on Aug. 12, photovoltaic generation temporarily declined, but because the event was highly predictable, much of the effect could be anticipated by the market. By contrast, unexpected weather deviations produced much sharper price reactions. On  Aug. 28, weaker-than-forecast solar and wind generation created a renewable shortfall of more than 10 GW around midday, pushing intraday hourly prices to around €500/MWh and individual quarter-hours above €3,000/MWh. These changing conditions were also reflected in ancillary service markets. With periods of renewable oversupply becoming less frequent, the need for downward regulation increased in relative terms, supporting stronger revenues in negative aFRR. At the same time, opportunities in positive aFRR became less pronounced than in July. The overall picture was therefore not simply one of higher prices. Rather, the timing of renewable generation, short-term scarcity and forecast deviations increasingly determined where trading opportunities emerged. Beyond price August underlines an important distinction for battery trading. Higher electricity prices do not automatically translate into higher revenues in every market. What matters is how those prices are structured across the day, how quickly market conditions change, and the ability to respond when the opportunities emerge. The month also highlighted the growing importance of forecast accuracy. Predictable changes in renewable generation, such as the partial solar eclipse, can be anticipated by the market. Unexpected deviations, by contrast, can trigger much sharper price movements and create short-lived but valuable trading opportunities. Looking ahead, the transition into autumn is likely to bring another change in market dynamics. Shorter daylight hours will reshape intraday price profiles, while changing weather patterns could increase uncertainty around renewable generation. For battery operators, the key will be to combine accurate forecasting with dynamic cross-market optimization as the timing and shape of value continue to change. title: Spain awards €265 million for 49.9 GWh of pumped hydro storage - Energy Storage
content: Spain has awarded €265 million (USD 302 million) to 11 pumped hydro energy storage projects totaling almost 4.1 GW / 49.9 GWh across two rounds of its BORALMAC funding program. The two rounds, resolved between 2024 and 2026, support new pumped hydro facilities as well as projects using existing infrastructure. The projects are spread across seven Spanish autonomous communities and are expected to be completed by 2035. The first BORALMAC round, resolved in July 2024, awarded the full €100 million available to four projects totaling almost 2 GW of turbine capacity and 28.85 GWh of storage. The largest award, €44.9 million, went to the BOREAL project in Alcántara, Extremadura, for the new José María de Oriol II pumped hydro plant using the existing Alcántara II and Cedillo reservoirs. Two projects in Castilla y León will make use of drainage water from abandoned mines. The Navaleo pumped hydro project in Torre del Bierzo received €35.3 million, while the Velilla del Río Carrión project in Palencia was awarded €10.7 million. The fourth project, EcoEbre in Tarragona, received €9.1 million for a closed-loop pumped hydro facility between two reservoirs. The original completion deadline for BORALMAC 1 projects was the end of 2030. An amendment from the Institute for the Diversification and Saving of Energy (IDAE), approved in January 2026, allows the deadline to be extended to Dec. 31, 2035. BORALMAC 2 initially had a €90 million budget, but this was increased to €165 million following 16 applications seeking a combined €440 million in funding. Seven projects were ultimately selected, representing 2.07 GW of turbine capacity and 21.09 GWh of storage, against more than €755 million in eligible project costs. The second-round projects include the 545 MW / 4.29 GWh Baells facility in Barcelona and the 354 MW / 4.74 GWh La Barca project in Asturias, which has the largest energy storage capacity among the seven projects. Other awards went to the 440 MW / 3.52 GWh Meirama project in A Coruña, the 357 MW / 2.97 GWh Los Guajares project in Granada, the 247 MW / 3.81 GWh Grandas de Salime project in Asturias, and the 95 MW / 772 MWh Dehesa de Ganaderos project in Zaragoza. The 33 MW / 991 MWh TORREALII project in Cáceres is the only BORALMAC 2 project that will use existing infrastructure rather than construct a new pumped hydro plant. All seven BORALMAC 2 projects must be completed by June 30, 2035. The second round is funded through the REPowerEU component of Spain’s Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan, while BORALMAC 1 was funded separately under the plan’s electricity infrastructure, smart grids, flexibility and storage component. IDAE said the projects were assessed on economic viability, technical characteristics, permitting maturity and their ability to support renewable integration and provide system services, including inertia and black-start capability. title: Geely's AI fast charging 'heals' EV batteries for 20% more cycle life
content:
Geely says its new AI-powered fast charging system can reverse some of the battery damage caused by fast charging, using micro-pulse currents to add up to 20% more cycle life.
Charging a car in under 5 minutes is great, but not if it wears the battery out years early. Geely claims that its ‘Smart Charging’ addresses that and it is using something that sounds like sorcery.
A 2.25 MW charger was only half the story
Earlier this week, we reported that Geely one-upped BYD with a 2.2 MW charger capable of 4-minute EV charges. The full announcement came on Wednesday in Ningbo, and the fifth-generation Geely Smart Charging Station is rated at up to 2,250 kW peak.
Geely also shared real-world results. In testing, the battery used in the Lynk & Co 10 and Zeekr 001 went from 10% to 70% in 4 minutes 30 seconds, and from 10% to 97% in 8 minutes 40 seconds.
That’s a hair quicker than BYD. Its 1,500 kW Flash Charging network, now at over 10,000 stations, takes Blade Battery 2.0 from 10% to 70% in 5 minutes and to 97% in 9 minutes.
But Geely spent most of its presentation on something else: what all that power does to the battery.
Micro-pulses to undo fast-charging damage
The main way fast charging hurts a lithium-ion cell is lithium plating. Push current in too fast and some lithium ions pile up on the surface of the anode (the negative electrode) instead of slotting into it. That lithium stops cycling, and the pack slowly loses capacity.
Geely’s answer is what it calls “lithium-ion pulse restoration technology.” The system sends micro-pulse currents through the cells to “reactivate” the lithium ions that accumulated at the negative electrodes during repeated fast charging.
Combined with AI-managed charging, Geely claims this increases battery cycle life by 20%. The bullet points in its press release say “up to 20%,” so treat that as a best case.
There’s also a home charging component. Geely says it developed a low-rate charging strategy that “gradually” fixes degradation from repeated fast charging while you’re plugged in at home overnight.
So the idea is that you fast charge on road trips, and your slow charger at home cleans up after it.
AI that predicts heat 30 seconds ahead
The brain behind all of this is Xingrui PowerMind, an energy AI model Geely co-developed with Chinese AI startup StepFun. It coordinates the vehicle, battery, charger, cloud, grid, and the station’s energy storage system.
Most EVs today cut charging power once the pack is already hot. Geely says PowerMind looks up to 30 seconds into the future instead, forecasting where battery temperature is heading and dialing power down before it gets there. Every car and battery gets its own profile, with the AI constantly changing how much current goes in, how hard the cooling works, and how long the session runs.
The targets: an average battery temperature of 55°C during charging, and a peak under 65°C.
To hit those numbers at 2.25 MW, Geely added what it calls the industry’s first five-point liquid cooling system. It cools the station’s energy storage battery, the charging pile, the cable, the charging port, and the battery pack, so no single link in the chain becomes the bottleneck.
A 6C battery for cheaper EVs
Geely also listed two batteries. The Shendun Golden Battery, the one used in the Lynk & Co 10 and Zeekr 001 tests, supports a peak charging rate of 12C.
And the one that matters more for most buyers is the Next-Gen Ultra Short Blade Battery. It’s meant for Geely’s more affordable models. Thanks to laser welding Geely developed for the cell tabs and covers, the company says the pack generates 10% less heat while charging, and peak charging rate goes up to 6C.
If it holds up, that brings 10-minute-class charging to cars that don’t cost Zeekr money.
Electrek’s Take

It is impressive that a company is even considering this as it is something that adds longevity to your car. title: Green Water & Power powers up its 10,000th EV charger in just 3 years
content:
EV Charging
Jo Borrás
| Sep 25 2026 - 6:01 am PT
The developers and electricians at Green Water & Power are celebrating a significant EV charging milestone this month with the deployment and energization of its 10,000th electric vehicle charging port –
in just three years
Green Water & Power (GWP) and their hardware partners, Autel, started rolling out L2 chargers together nationwide in 2023. Earlier this month, the companies powered up their 10,000th charger. That’s a headline number – but the real story is just how quickly they got there: 10,000 chargers.
For those of you doing the math, that’s nearly 10 chargers going online each day, every day, including Sunday, Thanksgiving, Christmas, and New Years’, for three (3) solid years. And, for what it’s worth, they don’t seem to be slowing down.
“From the outset,
we designed our charging hardware and supporting software to deliver reliability and flexibility at scale
,” said Michelle Luo, CEO of Autel Energy. “GWP has demonstrated what that looks like in practice by consistently exceeding industry benchmarks across their entire network. This partnership shows how dependable technology and strong execution can accelerate EV adoption nationwide.”
Getting charging to work, and home
DCFC, by Green Water & Power.
Green Water & Power is currently contracted to install over 3,000 additional Level 2 chargers and more than 100 DC fast chargers (shown, above) in the coming months, with other projects in various stages of development.
To their credit, however, GWP is quick to point out that speed of deployment doesn’t mean much if the network isn’t reliable.  “Property owners and drivers don’t care about how many chargers we’ve installed,” explains Danny Gold, President of Green Water & Power. “
They care that the one in front of them works every time they need it
. That reliability is what’s made Autel Energy a great partner for us since day one, and it’s what let us scale into every vertical our customers operate in, from hotels and apartments to schools and hospitals.
We’re just getting started
The company claims its network has delivered a combined 16.6 million kWh to date, maintaining an average uptime of 99.72%
and displacing more than 22,000 metric tons of CO2 emissions

title: Lexus' electric 3-row SUV makes its first public appearance
content:
Peter Johnson
| Sep 25 2026 - 6:53 am PT
The 2027
Lexus TZ
is the first purely electric three-row SUV from Toyota’s luxury brand. Ahead of its upcoming launch, the electric TZ was spotted driving in public for the first time.
When is Lexus launching the electric TZ?
We got our first look at the
new 2027 Lexus TZ
in May, an upscale sibling to the upcoming Toyota Highlander BEV.
It’s based on the same platform as the electric Highlander and will be available with two battery pack options: 76.96 kWh and 95.82 kWh, which Lexus said will deliver a driving range of up to 300 miles on a single charge.
Unlike Toyota’s 3-row SUV, all 2027 Lexus TZ models come with an “evolved” version of its DIRECT4 AWD system.
The dual-motor all-wheel drive (AWD) setup packs a combined 420 horsepower and enables it to tow up to 3,500 lbs. Drivers will be able to choose from five unique drive modes that will automatically optimize drive settings: normal, sport, eco, range, and rear comfort.
2027 Lexus TZ electric three-row SUV (Source: Lexus)
Although it uses the same platform as the Highlander EV, Lexus said the TZ will stand apart with its signature driving experience. In fact, Lexus claimed the electric TZ has the quietest cabin of any of its SUVs to date, with a fine-tuned suspension, dynamic rear steering, and a reinforced body structure.
Inside, the TZ features the latest Lexus Interface Multimedia system. The system now includes customizable apps and widgets, plus an updated “Hey Lexus” voice assistant.
The infotainment system now offers full-screen navigation and added EV charging functions, like EV Routing and an EV Range Map.
At 200.8″ long, 78.3″ wide, and 67.1″ tall, with a 120.1″ wheelbase, the Lexus TZ is about the size of other three-row EV SUVs, including the
Hyundai IONIQ 9
and Volvo EX90.
With charging speeds of up to 150 kW, the electric TZ can charge from 10% to 80% in about 35 minutes. It also has a NACS port, so drivers can charge at Tesla Superchargers without needing a separate adaptor.
The 2027 Lexus TZ is expected to go on sale in late 2026 or early 2027. With its official launch coming up, the electric SUV was spotted driving in Toronto while filming a commercial.
A few images and a video of the TZ were posted on the #Torontocarspotting Facebook group (via Rigun KG) on Thursday.
Lexus has yet to announce prices for the 2027 TZ. Given that the
2027 Toyota Highlander BEV
is expected to start in the mid-$50,000 range, the Lexus TZ will likely start in the mid-$60,000 range as a more upscale option.

title: Tesla Semi finally enters volume production, 7 years behind schedule
content:
Tesla Semi
Fred Lambert
| Sep 25 2026 - 5:31 am PT
Image: Tesla
Tesla officially launched high-volume production of the Tesla Semi last night at its new dedicated factory in Nevada, a plant it says can build 50,000 electric trucks per year.
The Class 8 truck was unveiled in 2017 with production promised for 2019. Seven years later, Tesla says deliveries “start now,” and it detailed a heavily redesigned truck in a
13-post thread on X
A factory built only for Semi
Tesla held the launch event at the Semi factory next to Gigafactory Nevada in Sparks, where
the first truck came off the high-volume line back in April
According to Tesla, the plant covers 1.8 million square feet and builds every variant (Standard, Long Range, and a European spec) on the same line. Tesla called it “our first factory built for Semi.”
Tesla Semi factory in Nevada (Image: Tesla)
Tesla leaned hard on vertical integration. It says it stamps parts and builds the batteries, drive axles, high-voltage distribution, cooling modules, and even the seats in-house, while “most truck plants just assemble.” It also claims the first powder-coated Class 8 truck and one of its most automated battery lines to date.
“Vertical integration is the only real way to bring cost down,” Tesla wrote.
4680 cells, a cheaper motor, and electric steering
The truck itself has changed a lot since PepsiCo got the first hand-built units in late 2022. Tesla says it spent four years redesigning the Semi “for true volume.”
The biggest change is the battery. Tesla moved from 2170 cells to its in-house 4680 cells, which it says means “less battery mass & fewer kWh with no compromise on range.” Tesla didn’t give a new pack size. When it
released the final Semi specs in February
, it listed 325 miles for the Standard Range and 500 miles for the Long Range at 82,000 lbs, with consumption of 1.7 kWh per mile.
The Semi drive unit now uses a steel-caged rotor and a bar-wound stator shared with Cybertruck (Image: Tesla)
The drivetrain was reworked too. Tesla swapped the carbon-fiber-sleeved rotor for a steel-caged rotor that it says is cheaper, more reliable, and more efficient. The bar-wound stator is now shared with Cybertruck, a part Tesla already builds at volume.
Tesla also says Semi is the first heavy-duty truck with electric steering, which gets rid of the hydraulic pumps and fluids that leak and need servicing. And it’s upfront about why that matters beyond maintenance: it “lays the groundwork for future autonomy.”
Thermal management now runs through what Tesla calls a “Megamanifold,” a heat pump that handles cabin HVAC plus all powertrain heating and cooling. It’s the same thermal system Tesla uses in Cybercab.
Image: Tesla
Inside, there’s acoustic glass, a roll-down window, and a cabin you can stand up in. Tesla also automated parts of the pre-trip inspection and can generate electronic logs of when those checks were done. That’s a real quality-of-life feature for drivers.
Uptime, charging, and the diesel math
Tesla claims its Semi fleet has had over 98% uptime so far in 2026 and says the truck “requires almost no maintenance.”
On a Megacharger, Tesla says drivers get up to 60% of their range back in 30 minutes. It shared a map of Megacharger sites along major freight corridors, heavily concentrated in California, Texas, and the East Coast, with big gaps across the Mountain West and the Plains.
Tesla Megacharger sites along US freight routes (Image: Tesla)
Tesla’s economic pitch came down to one chart: fuel cost per mile for a diesel truck at 7 mpg versus a Semi at 1.7 kWh per mile using transportation electricity rates.
Fuel cost per mile: diesel at 7 mpg vs. Semi at 1.7 kWh/mi (Image: Tesla)
Based on Tesla’s chart, diesel has spiked back to roughly $0.80 per mile this year, while electricity has stayed in the $0.20 to $0.30 range. That gap is the whole business case, and it has widened in 2026.
Who’s buying
Deliveries start now, according to Tesla, which also says it will use Semis to haul its own freight.
Image: Tesla
Customer trucks at the event carried logos from PepsiCo, DHL, US Foods, ABF, Einride, IMC Logistics, and WattEV, among others. The big one came earlier this week:
the ZET SCALE alliance picked Tesla as primary supplier for 2,500 electric trucks
, an order that would nearly double the number of electric Class 8 trucks on US roads. That follows Einride’s 500-truck order in August.
Pricing is also a big advantage. Tesla hasn’t confirmed pricing since the event, but Electrek previously reported that Tesla has been
quoting $290,000 for the 500-mile Semi
and about $260,000 for the Standard Range. That’s up roughly 60% from the $180,000 Tesla advertised in 2017, but still about $145,000 below the average price of an electric Class 8 truck.
Electrek’s Take
As I have been saying for years, Tesla Semi is the last Tesla vehicle program that gets me excited, and despite the many delays, it is finally here.
The Semi is real, it’s in volume production, and on paper it’s the best electric Class 8 truck you can buy. It’s cheaper than the competition by six figures, and the efficiency claims have held up with fleets like PepsiCo.
Tesla can clearly build the trucks. Now it has to sell them, and the Megacharger network has to fill in fast enough outside California and Texas to make long-haul routes work. Diesel at $0.80 a mile helps a lot.
We’ll be watching the delivery numbers closely over the next few quarters. If Tesla ships 5,000 Semis in 2027, it’s a real business. If it ships 1,500, that factory is going to look awfully big.

title: Tesla ramps Optimus to hundreds a week, but the robots can't generalize
content:
Tesla Optimus
Fred Lambert
| Sep 25 2026 - 7:45 am PT
Tesla is now building several hundred Optimus humanoid robots per week at Fremont, roughly 10 times its Q2 output, according to a new report. But the robots coming off the line still can’t handle generalized tasks – limiting their usefulness.
The report also describes fragile hands, misaligned parts on the assembly line, and suppliers that can’t hold quality at volume. Those are the two problems that decide whether humanoid robots make money: generalization and reliability.
Hundreds of robots, mostly for Tesla
The Information reported this morning
(paywalled) that Tesla went from a few dozen Optimus units a week during small-batch testing in Q2 to several hundred a week in August. Managers are reportedly aiming for a continuous automated line capable of more than 1,000 robots a week by the end of the year, with an eventual target of about 20,000 a week.
That line lives where the Model S and Model X used to be built. Tesla ended production of its two flagship vehicles in early May and
converted the Fremont line to Optimus
, pulling workers and engineers from S/X, and dozens more from Model Y, onto the robot program.
So where are all these robots going? Mostly nowhere. According to the report, most units are used internally for testing, training, and data collection. The ones working inside Tesla’s factories are confined to tightly controlled, supervised areas, and they’re programmed for specific tasks rather than running as general-purpose machines.
And the V3 robots Tesla is building now aren’t even the version it plans to commercialize. That one still has to pass stricter durability and reliability thresholds.
The hands are the hard part
Musk has promised human-level dexterity for Optimus. Getting there at scale is proving painful.
Per The Information, the hand and forearm contain over 100 screws and small components that workers still assemble by hand. Fixtures on several stations, including hands, joints, and electronics testing, can’t consistently line up parts that are far smaller and tighter-tolerance than anything on a car. The result is more robots needing rework after coming off the line.
Durability is its own problem. Some of the hand’s touch sensors have had reliability issues, and Tesla’s fix is a replaceable “sensing glove” that it plans to add next year so it doesn’t have to swap the whole hand.
Then there’s the supply chain. Tesla relies on outside suppliers, many in China, for motors and the precision gears that drive the joints. Some of them can make good parts in prototype quantities but struggle to keep quality consistent at higher volume.
Days to learn a basic task
The bigger issue is the brain. Three people familiar with the system told The Information that Optimus’ AI can’t yet reliably handle a wide range of tasks, and that its behavior can be unpredictable in situations it hasn’t been trained on.
Tesla is trying to build a library of basic movements the robot can recombine for new jobs. But it still reportedly takes several days for Optimus to learn even basic tasks.
To feed the models, Tesla has over 500,000 hours of training data and wants to double that by year-end. It has moved much of its self-driving data annotation team to Optimus, hired dedicated data collectors wearing camera helmets and motion-capture suits, and set up training hubs in Colorado, Arizona, and Florida.
The plan for customers follows the same logic. Tesla reportedly intends to lease, not sell, Optimus to a short list of companies whose factories and warehouses look like its own, so the robots have an easier time adapting, and to use data from those deployments to improve the AI. That’s the FSD playbook: ship the hardware, collect the fleet data, and promise the software will catch up.
This is also a far cry from what Musk was saying last year. In January 2025, he said Tesla would build about 10,000 Optimus robots in 2025 and that “several thousand” would be doing useful work by year-end. A year later, he
admitted that zero Optimus robots were doing useful work at Tesla
. He also promised a V3 reveal by mid-2026. It’s late September, and that demo still hasn’t happened.
And competitors aren’t waiting.
XPeng started running an automated IRON humanoid production line
in Guangzhou this month, targeting commercial sales in 2027.
Electrek’s Take
We think humanoid robots will become a big new category of robots. But we also think they’ll be a small fraction of the overall robotics industry. For most jobs, a robot designed for that specific job, like a robotic arm on a line or a wheeled warehouse bot, will be several times more efficient than a robot shaped like a human. The humanoid’s only real advantage is that it can theoretically do anything in a space built for people.
That advantage only exists if two things happen. First, the AI needs to generalize. A humanoid that has to be trained for days on each task and kept in a fenced-off area is just an expensive, less efficient specialized robot. Nobody has cracked generalization yet, and it’s extremely hard to predict when anyone will. Second, the robot needs to be reliable enough over years of use to pay for itself. Touch sensors failing and 100+ hand-assembled parts per arm aren’t a great start.
Based on this report, Tesla has problems with both.
But it wouldn’t be the first time Tesla made big product decisions based on AI breakthroughs that haven’t happened yet. In 2016, it started telling customers every car it built had the hardware for full self-driving. It has since admitted HW3 cars will need an upgrade, and “Full Self-Driving” still requires supervision nearly a decade later. Now Tesla has killed the Model S and Model X to build a robot whose AI can’t do what the product needs it to do.
Maybe Tesla gets there. But the company is again betting its factory lines on a software timeline it can’t predict. How many times does that need to happen before investors start pricing it in?

title: Americans Are Buying Hybrids At A Record Pace. And It's Not Just Toyota Anymore
content:
Sure, Toyota is still the main player in the hybrid game. But other brands are stepping up in a big way.
Photo by:
Suvrat Kothari
4:20pm ET
Hybrids are
getting more and more popular in the U.S.
Much of that simply comes down to more automakers expanding their hybrid lineups, but Americans are also warming to the idea of electrification. High fuel prices and improvements in charging infrastructure have are helping people warm up to the idea of alternative fuels. With all of that, hybrids have the highest market share they've ever had, at 16.3% of the U.S. market, according to new data from Cox Automotive. While Toyota is still America's hybrid king through Q2 of 2026, two other brands saw surprising growth: Kia and Subaru.
Toyota still dominates the hybrid segment with 44% market share through Q2, despite dropping 4% from last year. That should come as no surprise, as Toyota practically invented the space. The
is still the most famous hybrid on the planet. However, another big reason why Toyota owns this segment is that it turned two of America's most popular models into hybrids exclusively; the Camry and RAV4. So now the zillions of people who buy those two cars have to buy hybrids.
The big surprise is Kia, though. Its share of the hybrid market is only 9%, but it saw a massive 130% year-over-year hybrid growth in Q3. That's in no doubt helped dramatically by the arrival of the new
Telluride Hybrid
. The Telluride is one of Kia's most popular models and the new hybrid model is arguably the best value in the lineup. The launch of that model last quarter had to have been a massive help, and likely will continue to bolster Kia's hybrid sales for many years to come.
Photo by: Kia
Subaru was behind Kia in terms of market share, with just 4%, but it saw even more proportional growth than Kia, with a 140% year-over-year improvement. That's coming from a low base, as Subaru had zero hybrids in 2024. It has since launched hybrid versions of the Forester and Crosstrek, with Wilderness versions coming, too.
American is clearly buying into electrification and Hybrids are a great gateway, as they allow customers to taste the benefits of it, without having to make a complete lifestyle change over to charging. Hybrids are more convenient for long range driving, too, so they work better for many families. title: EV Sales Keep Surging In Europe, Now Make Up 29% Of New Car Sales
content:
EV Sales Keep Surging In Europe, Now Make Up 29% Of New Car Sales
The market share for EVs keeps climbing, while traditional combustion cars continue to fall from grace.
- European new car buyers are loving EVs more and more.
- Last month, 29% of all new cars sold in the region were electric.
- From the beginning of the year through August, EVs beat both gas and diesel cars.
European car buyers are supercharging the region’s EV adoption rate with continually higher numbers. Last month, 29% of all new cars sold in Europe were electric, bringing the average market share for the January through August period up to 23%, according to the International Council on Clean Transportation (ICCT).
The data is backed by registration numbers published by the European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association (ACEA), the region’s main automotive lobby group, which show that 29.2% of all new cars registered last month in the European Union, UK, and EFTA countries were EVs, up from last year’s 20.2% share. The same lobby group says EVs have a year-to-date market share of 23.2%.
The BMW Group had the biggest share of EV sales, according to the ICCT. That's mostly due to the huge success of the new iX3 crossover.
Meanwhile, traditional combustion passenger cars, powered by either gas or diesel engines, continue to go down in popularity. In August, gas cars accounted for just 18.5% of all registrations, while diesel cars captured just 5.8% of the European market, according to ACEA. Through the first eight months of the year, combustion cars (gas and diesel combined) had a 27.9% market share, per ACEA, while the ICCT says that number was 29%.
That’s clearly more than the 23% share captured by EVs, but the trend is clear. Last year, EVs had 17.7% of the market at the end of August, while gas and diesel accounted for 35.8% of the new car market.
It’s great news for everyone, but especially for people who live in dense urban areas, where studies have shown that replacing combustion cars with EVs leads to significant health benefits.
Things are going so well that Volkswagen has found itself in the awkward situation where it needs to cut back combustion car production and boost EV assembly in its home country, which also happens to be the region’s biggest car market. Thanks to the huge success of the new ID. Polo, VW now has more orders for EVs in Germany than combustion cars, a first for the company.
The Volkswagen ID. Polo and Renault 5 have also been very successful in Europe.
But Europeans aren’t out of the woods yet. Even with hundreds of EV models to choose from, including dozens of affordable options, the gas engine still looms over the region’s car market in the form of mild hybrids and traditional hybrids.
Hybrids are now topping Europe’s car sales charts, getting 32.8% of the market in August. That said, with EVs going as hard as they are right now, the rise of hybrids has been somewhat tame compared to the United States, with a year-to-date market share of 36.3%, up from 34.7% during the same period last year, according to ACEA.
Among local automakers, BMW Group had the biggest share of EVs from January through August, with 30% of all cars sold being electric, the ICCT said. That’s 10 percentage points more than last year.
Norway is still the undisputed leader when it comes to the number of EVs registered, with a whopping 98% of all new cars registered from January to August being electric. Denmark is a close second, with 82%, followed by Finland with 50%, Iceland with 47%, and Sweden with 43%. Meanwhile, Croatia is at the bottom of the list, with only 4% of new cars registered being EVs, according to the ICCT.

title: The Volkswagen ID.4 Just Got Up to $12,500 Cheaper in America
content:
The Volkswagen ID.4 Just Got Up to $12,500 Cheaper in America
The current-generation ID.4 is on its last legs in the U.S., and Volkswagen is doing everything it can to clear dealer lots.
- Volkswagen is offering some sweet discounts on the ID.4 in the U.S.
- You can get the electric crossover for up to $12,500 less if you’re willing to buy an older model.
- However, even the latest model gets a substantial discount, so be ready to ask your dealer the right questions.
It’s a sad day whenever a car manufacturer decides to discontinue an electric model, but there’s no denying that the move often comes with a big benefit: substantial discounts for cars left in inventory.
That’s exactly what’s happening right now with the Volkswagen ID.4, which is going out of production at the brand’s Chattanooga plant in Tennessee to make room for more gas-powered SUVs.
The German automaker is slashing up to $12,500 off ID.4 EVs left in inventory across the country, turning the perfectly average crossover into a great deal. The massive price cut only applies to the 2025 ID.4, with “very limited inventory available,” according to Volkswagen.
Before the pitchforks come out in the comments section, everyone should know that the 2025 ID.4 is identical to the latest version, so you’re not giving anything up in terms of performance or features. Yes, it’s already one year old, but it’s still a new car at a great price.
But there’s more. If you absolutely want the latest model year, Volkswagen is also slashing the 2026 ID.4’s price by $6,000, which should make everyone happy.
The discount can be applied when leasing or purchasing with cash through participating dealers through November 2, and it’s only available for private customers. Bear in mind that not all dealers will advertise the Customer Bonus, so make sure you ask for it when shopping around.
It’s also worth noting that 2025 models, which can benefit from the bigger discount, are rarer than 2026 models, but I still managed to find a couple of them on VW’s website, and the final price is under $40,000. Most options I found were Pro models with the 77-kilowatt-hour battery and dual-motor all-wheel drive, which are good for 263 miles of range on a full charge.
That price is on par with the entry-level Tesla Model Y All-Wheel Drive, which offers a smidge more range (294 miles), but comes with a stripped-down interior.
Back in 2024, the ID.4 went through a mid-life refresh, which brought more power, more range, a new 12.9-inch infotainment system, and backlit controls for volume and the climate system. Sadly, though, the infuriating driver door window switches stayed the same.
Volkswagen is set to right all the wrongs that came with the ID.4. The updated ID. Tiguan is expected to feature more physical controls and a smoother infotainment system, similar to the ID. Polo.

title: This Audi EV Set A Guinness World Record By Driving 831 Miles Without Recharging
content:
That's an astonishing average efficiency of 8.76 miles per kWh.
Photo by:
2:23pm ET
Audi set a new Guinness World Record for the longest distance traveled in an electric car on a single charge.
The Audi A6 E-Tron went 831 miles without recharging.
The test happened in "regular traffic," but Audi didn't share the average speed.
The latest world record for the longest drive on a single charge didn't come from a Lucid, or Tesla, or even that funky new
Volkswagen thing
. Nope, it came from an ordinary
Audi A6 E-Tron
, the automaker announced on Thursday. Rally driver Miko Marczyk was the one behind the wheel, and he had to go all the way to Hel and back to do it. Hel, Poland, that is.
Marczyk set out in a standard Audi A6 e-tron Sportback on September 11 at 1:55 a.m, and drove it across Poland. The route snaked along the Vistula river to Hel, which sits on a peninsula in the Baltic Sea. He then turned around and came back. On just one charge, his A6 E-Tron Sportback covered 831 miles, making for an average efficiency of 7.09 kWh per 100 km (8.76 miles per kWh). The total drive took 45 hours, with an average ambient temperature of around 15 degrees Celsius.
Last year,
Lucid claimed the Guinness World Record
for the longest drive in an EV, covering 749 miles from Switzerland to Germany. The Air Grand Touring used in that test is America's rangiest EV, with an EPA rating north of 500 miles.
Photo by: Audi
Audi doesn't say what his average speed was, only saying that he drove the car in "regular traffic." As with any of these ultra-long EV range tests, we can only assume that slow speeds played a role. Cruising at highway speeds, there's no way the E-Tron would have gone this far. Same goes for the Lucid or the Chevy Silverado EV that GM engineers drove over a thousand miles.
Audi credits this efficiency to aerodynamics. With a drag coefficient of 0.21, the A6 E-Tron is one of the slipperier cars on the market and the most aerodynamic Audi ever. Audi also says that aerodynamic drag accounts for 40% of its electric A6's consumption, so its slippery shape helped it maintain efficiency at higher speeds.
Even with the Audi's pebble-smooth aerodynamics and its 94.9 kWh usable battery, Marczyk was shocked by the results. "Even for me, a result of 1,338 kilometers was a pleasant surprise," he said. It wasn't some slowpoke version of the car, either. It had 367 horsepower and could hit 62 mph in 5.4 seconds, the same as an off-the-shelf A6.
Stay informed with our newsletter every weekday
Does this mean you can achieve 800 miles-plus on a single charge with your Audi A6 E-Tron? Probably not. Marczyk was driving specifically to eke out every single mile possible, and was probably driving far too slow for the average highway driver to handle. Still, it proves that with a careful right foot and some patience, you can get some serious range out of a single charge.

title: Volkswagen Bets You'll Pay Up For In-Car Gaming
content:
VW's new gaming feature will let owners pair their smartphones as game controllers.
Photo by:
Volkswagen
2:05pm ET
Volkswagen will add the ability to game on the infotainment screen on some of its new cars.
20 titles will be available at launch, including Pac-Man, Uno, and Tetris.
Passengers can use their smartphones as controllers.
If your car has an
enormous screen molded into the dashboard
, you might as well use it for more than just checking the time or the weather. Across the board, car companies are teasing out what digital features customers are willing to use—and perhaps more importantly, pay for. Teslas just got Grok Bot, Benzes have ChatGPT, and Cadillacs have HBO.
Volkswagen's latest move: bringing video games to some of its newer cars. The automaker announced on Wednesday that it will expand an existing partnership with AirConsole to several of its vehicles in the U.S. beginning with the 2027 model year. Tesla has had gaming in its cars for years, but this is a little different; passengers can crowd around the
car's central screen
and use their phones as wireless controllers.
Photo by: Volkswagen
Setup seems to be dead simple. Open your smartphone's camera app, scan a QR code, and start tapping away on the virtual controller. Depending on the game, multiple passengers can join in to a single session.
VW says that 20 of AirConsole's
50 games for cars
will be available at launch, including Pac-Mac, Uno, and Tetris. Some of the games will even be customized to the brand—for example, Pac-Man's pellets are Volkswagen logos and the in-game Power Berries are replaced by "iconic Volkswagen vehicles." Some of the titles will also integrate with in-car ambient lighting to allow for a more immersive experience.
And before you ask, no, the feature can't be used when the car is in motion.
The car must be parked before firing up the app

Volkswagen says that the feature will be baked into certain vehicles starting with the 2027 model year, including the
, Atlas, Golf GTI, Golf R, and Tiguan.
The feature also won't be free. It requires an active subscription to VW's In-Vehicle Premium connectivity service, which costs $149 per year. The service also includes connected navigation, a wifi hotspot, premium voice control (on supported models), premium radio, and access to myQ Connected Garage. ID. Buzz buyers get 12 months of connectivity included with their vehicle purchase, while other models receive 3 months.

title: Counterpoint：2025-2030 年间，全球 200 美元以下智能手机年出货将减少超 2.3 亿部
content:
9 月 25 日消息，当地时间 24 日，Counterpoint Research 发布的最新《按价格区间划分的智能手机出货量预测》追踪报告预计，2025 年至 2030 年间，全球 200 美元
（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,343 元人民币）
以下智能手机的年出货量
将减少超过 2.3 亿部
，降幅约 40%。
与此同时，全球智能手机整体市场会逐步恢复，到 2030 年末的出货规模
将接近 2025 年水平
价格段走势出现明显分化，根源在于 2026 年至 2027 年市场低迷带来的结构性冲击。内存和芯片组涨价、最低配置门槛提高，加上 OEM 厂商不再愿意为非战略性市场投入过多资源，都会显著减少入门级手机的供应。
改买价格更高的机型
，另一部分消费者则会
延长现有手机的使用时间
。二手手机也会分流部分需求，而在手机价格本就严重制约移动互联网普及的市场，首次购机人群增速也可能放缓。
到 2030 年，全球智能手机出货量
预计恢复至约 12 亿部
，只比 2025 年略低。200 美元以下机型的出货量预计仍将减少约 40%，200 美元及以上机型则预计增长约 26%。其中，入门级市场会贡献最大部分的降幅，因为这类产品的零部件成本在整机物料成本中占比更高，厂商自行消化成本上涨的余地也更小。
不同价格段到 2030 年的增长走势会明显不同。高端智能手机出货量
预计保持约 7% 的复合年增长率
，较高价格段和中端价格段则基本不增长。中端市场缺乏增长尤其关键。
报告指出，如果低价手机减少只是因为消费者普遍升级到更贵的产品，与入门级市场相邻的价格段本应快速扩张。但预测显示，实际变化同时包含消费者向更高价格段迁移、延后换机以及部分新机需求直接消失。因此，200 美元以下市场减少的出货量
不会全部转移到更高价格段
影响还会延伸到智能手机市场之外。报告称，在中低收入国家，手机价格仍是阻碍移动互联网普及的主要因素之一，低收入消费者受到的影响最大。200 美元以下手机市场萎缩，或减慢消费者
从功能机和多人共用设备转向个人智能手机
的速度，也会让运营商、政府和整个移动产业在扩大有效联网、内容和增值服务覆盖时面临更大困难。
中端智能手机出货量虽然预计总体持平，但战略地位会进一步上升。OEM 厂商会把更多新品、营销预算和渠道资源
投向配置更高的大众市场机型
中端产品也会越来越多地配备
更大的内存和存储容量、5G 连接、更好的摄像头、更长的软件支持周期以及部分端侧 AI 功能
，同时把价格维持在广大消费者能够接受的范围内。

title: 世界第一辆汽车专利申请 140 周年“献礼作”，AMG 首款纯电专属架构 SUV 谍照再曝
content:

新车代号 X591，是 AMG GT 四门轿跑车对应的 SUV 车型。车身仍有部分伪装，整体造型却已相当清晰：流畅低伏的车顶配合宽厚有力的肩部线条，使整车兼具
轿跑 SUV 和运动旅行车的视觉特征
最新曝光的原型车可以完整看到座舱玻璃区域。新车还会
通过独有灯组设计强化辨识度
，车头配备 Y 形 LED 灯组和超大尺寸前格栅，车尾采用圆形尾灯。据悉，圆形尾灯或将成为 AMG 最新一批独立车型的代表性设计元素。
黑色铝合金轮毂同样十分醒目，大型制动盘和黄色制动卡钳清晰可见。座舱预计会采用与 AMG GT 四门轿跑车相近的多屏幕布局，同时凭借 SUV 车身为乘员和行李腾出更多空间。
动力部分，新车基于
专属纯电平台打造，采用 800V 电气系统，并搭载 Yasa 开发的轴向磁通电机。电池技术则借鉴 F1 赛车方案，通过液体直接冷却电芯。

。车内外扬声器会播放经过细致还原的模拟 V8 声浪，同时加入模拟换挡效果。

底盘配置同样会采用 AMG 最新技术，包括带半主动侧倾稳定功能的 AMG Active Ride Control 空气悬架，以及已经在谍照中现身的后轮转向系统。
据IT之家了解，全新 AMG 纯电 SUV 定于 10 月 17 日正式首发，发布活动将在斯图加特奔驰博物馆举行，当天恰逢卡尔 · 本茨为世界第一辆汽车申请专利 140 周年。

title: 前 R 星开发者哈特维克：《GTA 6》登陆任天堂 Switch 2“没什么意义”
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，据外媒 Wccftech 今天（25 日）晚间报道，前 R 星开发者杰里米 · 哈特维克认为，考虑到玩家群体和硬件条件等因素，《GTA 6》登陆 Switch 2 并没有太大意义。
哈特维克在 Kiwi Talkz 最新一期采访中直言：“我觉得这么做甚至没有什么意义，因为我不确定《GTA 6》的受众和 Switch 玩家群体有多少重合。如果你是 GTA 粉丝，你大概会直接买一台能玩 GTA 的主机。…… 明知道大家都会为了你的游戏去买 PS5，你还有必要费力做出一个体验很可能缩水的版本吗？毕竟游戏在上面的运行效果并不完全一样。没有必要。”
报道提到，先前《GTA 三部曲：最终版》就已登陆任天堂 Switch 平台，且贡献了“相当一部分”的销量。
哈特维克还提出了一个颇为有趣的可能性：《GTA 6》甚至可以推出手机版。“只要他们下决心去做，你就能在手机上玩《GTA 6》，因为这种技术已经存在，而且经过了验证。”
据IT之家了解，《GTA 6》定于 11 月 19 日发售，首发平台仅有 PS5 和 XBOX Series X|S。

title: 德国柏林警方借助人工智能监控摄像头打击犯罪，自动识别暴力和破坏行为
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，据央视新闻报道，德国柏林警方 24 日在一处犯罪高发区域启动一项计划，将借助人工智能监控摄像头打击犯罪。
据悉，柏林警方将在这项计划启动的前四周内，在科特布斯门地区安装并调试好人工智能监控摄像头，随后正式投入使用。警方还计划将该方案推广至市内其他犯罪高发区域。
柏林警方发表声明说，该摄像头通过“空间人工智能”技术分析人员动作，以识别潜在犯罪与暴力行为。摄像头配套的显示屏平时处于休眠状态，当人工智能系统自动识别到暴力和破坏行为时，显示屏将亮起并显示相关信息，警员也会收到信息推送，继而判断是否采取行动。
IT之家注意到，这并不是德国第一次寻求将 AI 功能引入到警方工作当中。今年 2 月，德国财政部、内政部和司法部宣布，将推进核心安全机构现代化改革，并引入 AI 技术加强对有组织犯罪的打击，重点聚焦金融犯罪、洗钱和毒品走私。
该国海关与联邦刑事警察局还将建立联合数据分析中心和联合调查团队，共同打击洗钱与毒品犯罪。克林贝尔透露，两部门将实现数据互通，并利用 AI 技术筛选海量数据、锁定犯罪嫌疑人。德国实行联邦制，各州警方负责日常执法与多数刑事案件调查，联邦警察则负责边境、铁路及航空安全。

title: 曝特斯拉 Optimus 产量扩至原有规模约 10 倍，规模化量产难题仍未解决
content:
感谢IT之家网友
9 月 25 日消息，The Information 今天（25 日）晚间报道称，特斯拉近几个月已将 Optimus 人形机器人的产量
扩大到原来的约 10 倍
（tenfold），然而
稳定规模化生产的难题
多名熟悉 Optimus 项目的人士透露，当前生产线面临的障碍包括
结构复杂的手部、自动化设备以及供应商方面的限制
两名熟悉生产工作的人士称，特斯拉上个月
每周可生产数百台机器人
，而第二季度进行量产前小批量测试时，每周产量只有几十台。管理人员已告知员工，公司希望在年底前建成一条
可连续运行的自动化产线
，将每周产能提升至 1000 台以上。即便如此，距离特斯拉最终计划实现的每周约 20000 台仍相差很远。
特斯拉 CEO 马斯克多次把 Optimus 称为公司最重要的产品。他认为，人形机器人未来可以承担
制造、数据中心维护以及烹饪、清洁
等各种日常工作。
特斯拉目前的营收主要依靠汽车销售，马斯克称，Optimus 将推动公司进一步向 AI 企业转型。
IT之家从报道中获悉，Optimus 的进度表经过了多次调整。人形机器人计划首次官宣还不到一年的 2022 年，马斯克便称 Optimus 最快可在次年做好投产准备。
今年 1 月，马斯克在世界经济论坛期间透露，公司有望在 2027 年底开始销售 Optimus。到了 4 月，他又说，公司“应该”能在年中展示即将推出的新版本，但年中过去了，特斯拉仍未公开演示。
马斯克也承认 Optimus 量产难度很高。他今年 7 月在财报电话会议上坦言，制造 Optimus 是一个非常复杂、需要解决的问题，扩大生产规模面临的挑战也很大。按照当时的预测，Optimus 将“很快”开始生产。
不过，要制造出真正能够销售给客户的机器人，特斯拉仍有大量工作尚待完成。知情人士称，目前从弗里蒙特工厂下线的 Optimus V3
并非最终面向客户销售的版本
。特斯拉仍在完善销售版本，而在正式商业化之前，产品还必须达到更严格的耐用性和可靠性标准。
两名熟悉设计的人士称，
V3 比此前版本更轻，摄像头数量更多，外形也更加接近人类
目前生产的大多数 Optimus 都用于特斯拉内部的测试、训练和数据收集，其中包括位于加州帕洛阿尔托的办公室。一名知情人士称，在特斯拉工厂内，机器人目前只在严格受控的区域工作，方便工作人员密切监督其动作和任务。在这种环境下，Optimus
按照预先设定的程序完成特定任务
，并不会作为通用型机器人运行，也不是由人员远程操控。
知情人士称，随着 Optimus 的运行表现逐步提高并趋于稳定，特斯拉计划逐渐扩大机器人的作业范围。
一名知情人士透露，特斯拉计划在初期向外部商业客户出租 Optimus，而不是直接销售。租期结束后，公司可以收回机器人，对设备进行升级或翻新。据悉，特斯拉计划利用 Optimus 在客户工厂和仓库收集的数据改进 AI 系统。
报道提到，特斯拉拟定了一份潜在客户短名单，入选企业通常拥有与特斯拉相近的工厂或仓库布局，因此 Optimus 进入这些场所后更容易适应新的工作环境。

content:

盖茨在接受 NBC 新闻《Meet the Press》节目采访时直言：“没有人认为靠行业自律就足够了。”
主持人克里斯滕 · 韦尔克问他，华盛顿是否需要通过立法介入时，盖茨回答：“
。执法部门和政界人士必须参与进来，讨论应该设置什么样的安全措施，又该怎样监督，而且这些要求
。这会给行业增加一些负担，但不会显著拖慢他们的工作。”
采访中，盖茨没有否认 AI 可能在几年内毁灭人类的风险。与此同时，他提醒美国人，另一种危险也不容忽视：
恶意群体甚至现在就有能力，借助 AI 造成大规模伤亡
。“AI 的能力当然足以推动某些事件发生，造成 10 亿人死亡。所以，即使要达到 100% 的程度相当困难，也从来没有一种武器能像

title: 畅销小说被指用 AI 创作，法国最有名文学奖龚古尔奖将其移出初选名单
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 25 日，法国最负盛名的文学奖项 —— 龚古尔奖主办方宣布，将海地裔加拿大作家泰利森 · 奥雷利安的畅销小说《C'etait Ca ou Mourir（要么就这样，要么死）》移出初选名单，原因是有人指控奥雷利安使用 AI 创作该书。
奥雷利安否认使用 AI 写作。围绕他的指控随后引发了有关种族、文学价值和原创性的争论，法国文学界也因此出现一场风波。
指控最早由鲜为人知的 X 账号“Balance ton Claude”在本周提出。随笔作家塞缪尔 · 菲图西后来称该账号归自己所有，并由他与其他身份未公开者共同运营。
“Balance ton Claude”称，将小说中的若干段落输入 AI 检测工具 Pangram 后，检测结果显示该书“几乎完全由 AI 写成”。然而也有一些专家认为，AI 检测工具是否可靠仍存在疑问。
AI 争议之后，奥雷利安又被曝早期作品涉嫌抄袭。报道提到，其 2012 年发表的一篇短篇小说抄袭了法国作家路易 · 鲍维尔一本著作中的部分段落，2013 年的一篇评论文章则抄自《菲律宾星报》。
巴黎龚古尔学院称，学院注意到针对奥雷利安的 AI 写作和抄袭指控，因此决定将《要么这样，要么死》移出名单，以维护奖项和学院的公信力。“学院的核心职责，是推广并表彰由人类作者创作的文学作品。”
龚古尔学院还称，希望借此表明学院坚决反对“创作借助 AI 生成的文本”，并将在 10 月 6 日公布短名单前不再发表评论。
《要么这样，要么死》是奥雷利安的首部长篇小说，讲述一名海地移民一路向北穿越拉丁美洲，最终抵达加拿大的故事。该书还获得了多项文学奖，并计划译成多种语言。

title: 第 48 届世界技能大赛在沪举办，新增 3 项人工智能相关赛项创历届之最
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，据央视新闻报道，9 月 22 日至 27 日，第 48 届世界技能大赛在中国上海举行。本届世赛上，人工智能走进赛题、操作台，成为选手训练和比赛的一部分。
本届世赛 64 个项目中，与 AI 直接相关的赛项有 8 个：智慧安防技术、软件测试、数字交互媒体设计、自主移动机器人、工业 4.0、云计算、网络安全、3D 数字游戏艺术。其中智慧安防技术、软件测试、数字交互媒体设计是本届新增，新增数量创历届之最。
这些赛项的 AI 含量，体现在具体的工作场景里。
- 智慧安防技术，选手要应用深度学习算法和大模型基础原理，让监控系统自动识别异常。
- 软件测试，AI 已从工具升级为协作伙伴，选手调用多个智能体自主进行测试，自己则从更宏观的行业视角分析问题。
- 数字交互媒体设计，要求选手完成沉浸式数字体验，涉及虚拟场景和智能数字创新。
- 自主移动机器人，比的是机器人自主导航、环境识别、智能抓取，是“具身智能”的实战训练。
- 工业 4.0，融合机器学习、数字孪生、增强现实，让设备和系统实现智能协同。
在与世赛同期举行的世界技能大会上，来自各国的嘉宾也会围绕人工智能与技能发展、绿色转型等议题展开深入交流。
IT之家查询获悉，世界技能大赛是由世界技能组织举办，是全球最高层级的职业技能竞赛，每两年举办一届。世赛项目覆盖制造、交通、建筑、信息、创意、服务等 6 大类。既有云计算、机器人系统集成等代表新质生产力的项目，也有健康和社会照护等贴近民生需求的项目。
本届赛事中国代表团共 220 人，其中包括 71 名参赛选手，将参加全部 64 个项目的比赛。参赛选手来自全国 21 个省份，其中男选手 58 名、女选手 13 名，学生 49 名、职工 22 名。选手平均年龄 21 岁，年龄最小的 18 岁，最大的 25 岁。

title: 罗永浩回应交个朋友代销劣质溜溜凳：2022 年 5 月已退出管理层，承认严重质量管理事故
content:
9 月 25 日消息，罗永浩今日发文回应了交个朋友直播间代销劣质溜溜凳事件，表达了自己的看法。
IT之家附原文如下：
我觉得交个朋友处理得没什么大问题啊：不小心代理销售了劣质产品，依法追究追讨供应商的同时，考虑到这类的官司旷日持久，就先拿钱给消费者做退款不退货的处理。所以我本来确实没想说什么，但是刚才看了一下，逼我表态的媒体 / 自媒体也有不少，那我就说说我的看法：
1. 我虽然 2022 年 5 月就退出了交个朋友管理层，但一直担任交个朋友的首席监督官。再次强调一下，整个交个朋友公司售卖的商品，即便像这次的凳子一样，
不是我自己直播时售卖的，我也一样会负责监督
2. 这件事之前之所以没有引起交个朋友运营部门足够的重视，是因为虽然卖了两三百万，但实际上日常退货及投诉的没有很多，所以他们疏忽大意了。不管怎么样，
这是一起严重的质量管理事故
。感谢媒体和网友们的监督，如果不是上了热搜，有可能到现在还没发现问题的严重性。
3. 我自己的团队又彻底调查了一下这个劣质溜溜凳产品全平台的销售情况，发现俞敏洪老师的东方甄选平台也卖了将近 1000 万，是该产品出货量最大的代理销售商。众所周知，交个朋友产品出了问题有罗永浩负责监督解决，东方甄选的产品出了问题，有俞敏洪老师负责“搞定”“摆平”。所以东方甄选历史上影响巨大的南美白虾、融安金桔、TiQ 西梅汁等等，甚至包括上了央视 315 晚会的槽头肉罐头，全都没有做全量退赔。希望这一次媒体和自媒体，如果没有什么说不出来、见不得人的隐情，也能公平公正公允地做好该做的热搜，承担好媒体监督行业的社会责任，不要义正辞严地“选择性执法”。感谢。
IT之家注意到，近日，有消费者称其在交个朋友直播间购买的一款“万向轮溜溜凳”存在严重质量问题，凳子内部使用的是发霉木板和废旧海绵等来路不明的废弃材料。
今日，针对消费者反映的问题，交个朋友直播间发布声明称第一时间全面下架了该产品，终止了与该品牌的合作，并在第一时间启动了退赔处理流程。该平台承诺，
所有购买过该产品的消费者，均做退款不退货处理
“交个朋友”就所售万向轮溜溜凳木板发霉等致歉：全面下架，启动退赔处理流程

title: 聊天、编程、智能体三合一，微软正式发布新版 Copilot“超级应用”
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，今天（25 日）晚间，微软正式发布新版 Copilot“超级应用”。新版 Copilot 把聊天、编程和智能体三类 AI 能力集中到同一个界面中。
微软为其给出的新定位是“为工作而生的 AI”，甚至把 Copilot 与 Office 当年对生产力的影响相提并论。微软 AI 工作业务首席营销官贾里德 · 斯帕塔罗表示：“正如 Office 定义了 PC 时代的工作方式，新 Copilot 旨在定义 AI 时代的工作方式。”
新版 Copilot 分为 Home、Code 和 Autopilot 三个标签页。Home 把 Copilot Chat 和 Cowork 整合到一起，也是用户打开 Copilot 后默认进入的页面。微软还计划在 Home 中加入 Today 功能，以个性化仪表盘的形式汇总重要邮件、会议请求、Teams 讨论串等信息。
斯帕塔罗介绍说：“Home 帮助你迅速掌握工作进展，让你清楚自己做到哪里并继续向前：查看近期活动，了解 Copilot 可以提供哪些帮助，再从上次停下的地方继续工作。”
借助 Code，任何人都能创建应用、跟踪器、仪表盘或自动化流程，再把成果以云端内部应用的形式分享给同事。Code 采用与 GitHub Copilot 相同的底层技术，在沙盒环境中运行，也可以安全托管在企业租户内。
Autopilot 同样是 Copilot 新增的重要部分，斯帕塔罗称其为“数字队友”。Autopilot 原名 Scout，最初是一款桌面应用；更名后的版本转向云端，让个人 AI 助手即使在用户睡觉时也能继续执行任务。
与其他许多 AI 智能体类似，Autopilot 拥有独立的云端计算机实例，可以监控 Teams 频道、定期执行工作任务，也可以负责后续跟进。
微软按照企业级标准打造了这套产品，目标用户包括大量依赖 Office 和微软身份管理套件的企业。斯帕塔罗解释道：“Autopilot 运行在你的租户中，拥有独立的身份、记忆、计算机和工作区，并以 Microsoft IQ 为基础，因此能够理解你的组织究竟如何运作。Autopilot 会直接进入员工日常使用的 Teams、Outlook、聊天、频道和文档，你可以像 @同事一样 @Autopilot，同时整套系统还具备权限、审计和治理机制。”
新版 Copilot 中的 Cowork、Code 和 Autopilot 都采用按使用量计费的机制，持续运行的智能体功能以及 Astra、Fable 等模型的调用，都将按照实际用量收费。
普通的 Copilot 用户订阅许可证，则覆盖 Chat 以及 Word、Excel、PowerPoint、Outlook 和 Teams 中的 Copilot 功能。
微软通过自动模型选择器为不同任务匹配模型，而 IT 管理员则需要借助新推出的 FinOps for AI 控制 AI 支出，防止智能体用量失控。
据IT之家了解，Home 和 Code 将在“未来几周”开始向微软 Frontier 计划的早期 AI 功能体验用户推送，Autopilot 将在本月晚些时候进入私人预览。Code 还计划于今年晚些时候向 Microsoft 365 Premium 和 Pro 订阅用户开放预览。

title: 英国最大 AI 超算面临供电问题：原定明年上线，或拖到 2030 年代中期
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，据英国《卫报》今天（25 日）报道，英国政府曾大力宣传的埃塞克斯郡劳顿大型数据中心项目将无法按原计划于明年启用，甚至可能拖到 2030 年代中期。
劳顿项目 2025 年公布时被称为英国最大的 AI 超级计算机，但供电难题意味着项目距离投入运行仍有很长一段时间。
当前，该项目因无法在原定 2027 年启用前获得足够电力而面临新的问题。该超算由英国初创企业 Nscale 负责建设，这家企业今年又计划以 350 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,351.04 亿元人民币）估值上市。
报道披露，负责把项目接入当地电网的 UK Power Networks（UKPN）已告知 Nscale，电网要到 2030 年代初至中期才能为数据中心提供足够电力。
Nscale 回应称，劳顿项目仍将推进。供电问题迟迟找不到快速解决办法，也反映出能源供应正成为数据中心建设的一大障碍。
Nscale 还清空了原先的脚手架堆场，同时开始研究场址内自行发电的可行性，以及能否缩短电网接入所需时间。
英国天然气与电力市场办公室（Ofgem）此前警告，电力接入申请已出现积压。数据显示，今年 6 月有 315 座数据中心正在排队接入英国电网，合计用电需求达到 73GW，而英国全国用电高峰需求仅为 45GW。
劳顿项目申请的供电容量最高达到 90MW，相当于约 31.5 万户家庭的用电量。

title: 长安汽车：深化与宁德时代合作，钠新换电技术项目立项
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，长安汽车 9 月 24 日公布投资者关系活动记录表，回答了钠电池量产时间等问题。
长安汽车表示，公司在钠离子电池领域已取得阶段性进展，钠离子电池突破高功率极片单点技术，提升极端温况续航体验；此外公司深化与宁德时代合作，钠新换电技术项目立项，共同研发新体系电池。
IT之家注意到，去年 4 月 21 日，宁德时代在首个超级科技日上发布全球首个大规模量产的钠电池 —— 宁德时代钠新，正式开启钠电产品从 0 到 N 的广泛应用。作为宁德时代全新的钠离子电池品牌，宁德时代钠新包含“钠新动力电池”和“钠新-24V 重卡启驻一体蓄电池”两类产品，均可实现零下 40℃ 至零上 70℃ 的全温域征服。
宁德时代此前称，钠新乘用车电池将彻底解决用户在极寒场景下的车辆性能衰减难题。以常见的 2.95 米轴距的车型为例，宁德时代钠新电池在混动车上的纯电续航可突破 200km，纯电车型续航将突破 500km，满足极端低温下的日常通勤和出行需求。

title: 陈立武：英特尔会维持在台积电前十大客户之列，我很敬佩张忠谋
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，据台媒《经济日报》今天（25 日）晚间报道，英特尔 CEO 陈立武近期接受采访时称，会维持在台积电前十大客户名单之列。
陈立武表示，美国拥有芯片设计和制造能力十分重要。随着先进制程节点不断微缩、复杂度持续提升，公司将推动相关领域取得进展。同时，英特尔仍是台积电的密切合作伙伴，也是台积电前十大客户之一。
陈立武称，即使自己喜欢赢，也不会把别人视为竞争对手。商业领域往往并非零和博弈，没有人能够把所有事情都包揽下来，因此总是需要寻找合作伙伴，而他自己也相当重视合作伙伴。
IT之家从报道中获悉，陈立武自曝“很敬佩”台积电创始人张忠谋，认为其为半导体产业作出了巨大贡献。英特尔一直与台积电保持密切合作，也是台积电前十大客户之一，今后还会继续保持这种合作关系。

title: 首个入驻纽约时代广场的中国影像品牌，影石首家美国旗舰店开业
content:
感谢IT之家网友 不一样的体验 的线索投递！
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，影石今日宣布，首家美国旗舰店于纽约时代广场正式开业。据此前官方介绍，这也是首个在纽约时代广场开业的中国影像品牌。截至目前，影石在全球体验零售店已超 10000 家，品牌旗舰店超 300 家。
IT之家注意到，国际数据公司（IDC） 9 月 23 日发布 2026 年二季度全球手持智能影像设备市场数据。期内全球销量达 588.7 万台，同比增长 57.24%；销售额 156.89 亿元人民币。其中云台相机增长最快，销量同比激增 86.9% 至 279.3 万台。
中国影像双雄影石、大疆成为本轮增长的核心引擎。影石披露，其相机全球累计出货量已突破 1000 万台，过去一年出货达 470 万台。全景相机领域，影石以 72.5% 的销量领跑行业，实现连续两个季度份额增长。
云台相机赛道，市场消息显示，影石首款产品 Luna Ultra 上市当月拿下美国亚马逊 23% 市场，6-8 月保持两成左右份额，打破行业长期以来的单一竞争格局。

title: 高盛：美国五大云巨头每年 AI 收入 3000 亿美元，才可盈亏平衡
content:
IT之家 9 月 25 日消息，据彭博社今天（25 日）晚间报道，高盛集团策略师预计，美国五大超大规模云服务商亚马逊、Alphabet、微软、甲骨文和 Meta 的 AI 基础设施支出将在明年增长超过 50%，达到 1.2 万亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 8.06 万亿元人民币）。
瑞安 · 哈蒙德带领的高盛团队在报告中指出，这一数字高于华尔街对明年资本支出 1.1 万亿美元（现汇率约合 7.39 万亿元人民币）的共识预期。按照高盛的测算，要收回这些投入，未来数年中，五家公司每年需要创造约 3,000 亿美元（现汇率约合 2.02 万亿元人民币）的 AI 收入。
哈蒙德及其同事称：“按照市场共识预期，明年资本支出占 GDP 的比重，将达到 19 世纪末铁路建设热潮以来历次技术投资周期中的最高水平。”
亚马逊、Alphabet、微软、甲骨文和 Meta 预计今年将在 AI 能力建设上投入 8,000 亿美元（现汇率约合 5.37 万亿元人民币）。高盛团队认为，明年的支出仍会大幅增长，但资本支出增速将开始放缓。
策略师指出，与近几个季度相比，资本支出增速，以及实际支出高于市场共识预期的幅度，都将有所下降。
五家公司的资本支出目前超过经营活动现金流，对债务和股权融资的依赖随之增加。电力、劳动力和内存供应不足，以及数据中心建设限制，都可能成为扩张过程中的制约因素。
高盛预计，五家公司的资本支出增速将从今年的接近 100% 降至明年的 54%，2028 年再降至 12%，届时支出规模预计达到 1.4 万亿美元（现汇率约合 9.4 万亿元人民币）。
策略师称，要让五家云服务巨头获得稳健回报，并让应用提供商在承担计算成本后取得较高利润率，AI 用户每年需要在各类应用上支出约 1 万亿美元（现汇率约合 6.72 万亿元人民币）。作为对比，今年全球软件支出约为 1.5 万亿美元（现汇率约合 10.08 万亿元人民币）。
高盛团队指出，目前估算的 AI 收入仍不足以让五家公司收回投入，不过收入增长速度很快。亚马逊、Alphabet、微软和甲骨文的云业务收入增速已从 2024 年的 25% 升至今年第二季度的 48%。此外，亚马逊、Alphabet 和微软公布的云业务待履约收入合计达到 1.7 万亿美元（现汇率约合 11.42 万亿元人民币）。

Embodied AI: Wenn Künstliche Intelligenz die reale Welt versteht und gestaltet
Künstliche Intelligenz verlässt die digitale Welt und wird zum aktiven Teil von Maschinen, Robotern und Produktionssystemen. Wie Unternehmen diese Technologie erfolgreich nutzen können, zeigt der 7. KI-Kongress am 18. November 2026 in Stuttgart. Noch bis 7. Oktober 2026 gilt der Frühbucherpreis.
Künstliche Intelligenz hat in den vergangenen Jahren beeindruckende Fortschritte erzielt. Doch die nächste Entwicklungsstufe industrieller KI geht weit über die bisher primär verbreitete Verarbeitung von Daten hinaus: Sie verbindet digitale Intelligenz mit der physischen Welt. Embodied AI meint KI-Systeme, die ihre Umgebung wahrnehmen, aus Erfahrungen lernen und darauf aufbauend eigenständig handeln. Damit geht Embodied AI über den Begriff Physical AI hinaus, der vor allem die physische Interaktion intelligenter Systeme mit ihrer Umwelt beschreibt.
Dies eröffnet Industrieunternehmen einen neuen Weg zu flexibleren, produktiveren und resilienteren Produktionssystemen sowie große Vorteile im globalen Wettbewerb: »Embodied AI ist aus meiner Sicht die größte, und möglicherweise letzte, Chance für den deutschen Maschinenbau, seine Technologieführerschaft zu behaupten und auszubauen«, sagt Prof. Marco Huber. Er ist wissenschaftlicher Direktor am Fraunhofer-Institut für Produktionstechnik und Automatisierung IPA, hat den KI-Kongress gemeinsam mit Werner Kraus, Forschungsbereichsleiter Automatisierung und Robotik, inhaltlich gestaltet und wird den Kongress mit einer Keynote eröffnen. Wer heute investiere, baue einen Vorsprung auf, der für Nachzügler kaum einholbar sein wird. »Die Frage ist nicht, ob Embodied AI die industrielle Produktion transformiert, sondern wer diese Transformation anführt.«
Welche Potenziale diese Entwicklung bietet und wie Unternehmen davon profitieren können, zeigt das Fraunhofer IPA als wissenschaftlicher Kooperationspartner gemeinsam mit der Konradin Mediengruppe beim 7. KI-Kongress »Embodied AI als Schlüssel für die Industrie« am 18. November 2026 im neuen Gebäude V für »Personalisierte Produktion« in Stuttgart-Vaihingen. Das Ministerium für Wirtschaft, Handwerk und Tourismus Baden-Württemberg hat für den Kongress die Schirmherrschaft übernommen. Ein Video-Grußwort der Ministerin Frau Dr. Nicole Hoffmeister-Kraut eröffnet die Veranstaltung.
Von Embedded Systems zu Embodied AI
Während generative KI heute vor allem digitale Inhalte erstellt und analysiert, geht Embodied AI einen entscheidenden Schritt weiter. Die Technologie verbindet Wahrnehmung, Weltmodellierung, Lernen und physisches Handeln in einem Gesamtsystem. Die KI wird damit zum integralen Bestandteil von Maschinen, Robotern und Anlagen. Sie verarbeitet nicht nur Informationen, sondern interagiert aktiv mit ihrer Umgebung und entwickelt ihre Fähigkeiten durch Erfahrungen kontinuierlich weiter.
Für die Industrie besitzt dieser Ansatz große strategische Bedeutung.
Produktionsunternehmen stehen vor der Herausforderung, immer komplexere Prozesse zu beherrschen, steigende Variantenvielfalt zu bewältigen und gleichzeitig Produktivität und Qualität zu sichern. Herkömmliche Automatisierungskonzepte stoßen dabei zunehmend an Grenzen. Embodied AI schafft neue Möglichkeiten, indem Maschinen Situationen selbstständig erfassen, Zusammenhänge verstehen und ihr Verhalten flexibel an veränderte Bedingungen anpassen können. Dadurch werden Produktionssysteme robuster, autonomer und leistungsfähiger.
Das Fraunhofer IPA treibt diese Entwicklung gezielt voran und hat bereits einen ersten Demonstrator für die additive Fertigung entwickelt. Auch Entwicklungen rund um die KI-basierte und humanoide Robotik veranschaulichen Embodied-AI-Systeme. Als Brücke zwischen Forschung und industrieller Anwendung untersucht das Institut zudem, wie sich Embodied-AI-Konzepte in Robotik, Produktion und Maschinenbau nutzbar machen lassen. Ziel ist es, die traditionellen Stärken des Industriestandorts Deutschland mit den Möglichkeiten moderner KI-Technologien zu verbinden und Unternehmen beim Aufbau wettbewerbsfähiger, intelligenter Produktionssysteme zu unterstützen.
KI-Kongress zeigt Status Quo in Unternehmen
Vor diesem Hintergrund widmet sich der 7. KI-Kongress den aktuellen Entwicklungen an der Schnittstelle von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Robotik und Produktion, denen großes Wachstum vorausgesagt wird: So dürfte das Marktvolumen für Embodied AI laut Marketsandmarkets voraussichtlich von 4,44 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2025 auf 23,06 Milliarden US-Dollar im Jahr 2030 steigen, was einer durchschnittlichen jährlichen Wachstumsrate (CAGR) von 39 Prozent entspricht.
Beim KI-Kongress zeigen Expertinnen und Experten aus Industrie und Forschung anhand konkreter Anwendungsfälle, wie intelligente Systeme Wahrnehmung, Entscheidungsfindung und physische Handlung miteinander verbinden. Im Fokus stehen unter anderem Fragen danach, wie Roboter über längere Zeiträume hinweg aus Erfahrungen lernen können, wie sich Embodied AI in bestehende Produktions- und IT-Landschaften integrieren lässt und wie agentische Fertigungsprozesse entstehen, die aus realen Produktionsergebnissen lernen. Ebenso wird diskutiert, welche Rolle verkörperte Intelligenz für die nächste Generation industrieller KI-Systeme spielen wird.
Labortour zeigt Embodied-AI-Grundlagen für künftige Anwendungen
Bei einer Tour durch die Labore des Fraunhofer IPA können die Teilnehmerinnen und Teilnehmer des Kongresses technologische Grundlagen für Embodied-AI-Anwendungen kennenlernen. Dazu gehört beispielsweise ein Drucker für die additive Fertigung. In diesem Anwendungsfall kommen Filamente aus recyceltem Material zum Einsatz. Diese Filamente sind nicht homogen. Der Prozess musste bisher ständig manuell nachgesteuert werden, um ein einheitliches Druckerzeugnis zu erhalten. Embodied AI automatisiert dies, indem es im laufenden Druckprozess auf Abweichungen reagieren und die Prozessparameter in Echtzeit anpassen kann. Das steigert die Qualität und senkt gleichzeitig den Materialverbrauch.
Ein weiteres Exponat sind verschiedene Humanoide Roboter in Aktion. »Wir haben mehrere Modelle mit je eigener Kinematik und unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten«, erklärt Werner Kraus. »Die Gäste erleben die Roboter live und in Aktion und erfahren Möglichkeiten der Anwendungsentwicklung mithilfe von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI). Und auch offene Fragen wie die Themen Sicherheit, Zuverlässigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit werden adressiert.« Weitere Demonstratoren sind in Planung.
Wissenstransfer für die industrielle KI von morgen
Der Kongress richtet sich an Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider, Fach- und Führungskräfte aus Industrie und Produktion, Innovationsverantwortliche sowie Entwicklerinnen, Entwickler und Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure, die konkrete Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI identifizieren und die digitale Transformation ihrer Unternehmen aktiv gestalten möchten. Neben Fachvorträgen bietet die Veranstaltung vielfältige Gelegenheiten zum Austausch und einen geführten Rundgang durch die Forschungslabore des Fraunhofer IPA.
Mit seiner Initiative zu Embodied AI und seiner Mitgestaltung des diesjährigen KI-Kongresses schafft das Fraunhofer IPA eine Plattform für den Wissenstransfer zwischen Forschung und Industrie. Ziel ist es, Unternehmen frühzeitig auf die nächste Evolutionsstufe der Künstlichen Intelligenz vorzubereiten und Wege aufzuzeigen, wie sich die Potenziale lernender, handelnder Systeme in konkrete industrielle Wettbewerbsvorteile übersetzen lassen. Denn klar ist: Die Zukunft der industriellen KI wird nicht nur digital sein. Sie wird die reale Welt aktiv mitgestalten.
7. KI-Kongress: „Embodied AI als Schlüssel für die Industrie“
Schnell sein und noch bis 7. Oktober vom Frühbucherpreis profitieren:

title: BTU-Statiker liefert neue Erkenntnisse zu antikem Palast in Äthiopien
